objective: Determine whether the specified product variant (Workshop Saw and Cutter from Scheppach, Scheppach Professional BTS 17O-1W7, mitre saw, 230V, 2200W) is carried in the product catalog.

params.product_family_id: lookup from product_families WHERE brand = 'Scheppach' AND product_family_name = 'Scheppach Professional BTS 17O-1W7 Workshop Saw and Cutter'
params.product_sku: lookup from product_variants WHERE product_family_id = $product_family_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'machine_type' AND property_value_text = 'mitre saw') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'voltage' AND property_value_text = '230 V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'power' AND property_value_text = '2200 W')
